html:
The Kongabula, or Gungabula, were an Aboriginal Australian people of inland Queensland, in the headwaters of the Dawson River below the Carnarvon Range.

Little is recorded about them. Their neighbours were the Yiman down the Dawson, the Garingbal of the Carnarvon country, the Nguri and the Mandandanji to the south. The sandstone gorges of this region hold some of Queensland's best known rock art. Squatters took up the upper Dawson in the 1850s.
sum: The Kongabula, or Gungabula, were an Aboriginal Australian people of inland Queensland, in the headwaters of the Dawson River below the Carnarvon Range.
